articles.title: Welcome to The 201 Invitational
articles.author: Michael Huss
articles.excerpt: One official home for the champions, collapses, power rankings and receipts dating back to 2012.
articles.body:
Welcome to The 201 Invitational.

Since 2012, we have made champions, created rivalries and found extraordinary new ways to argue about fantasy football. This site finally puts all of it in one place.

Start with the League History archive for the full championship ledger, then visit the Power Rankings page for the 2026 and dynasty pecking orders. More articles, records and questionable commissioner decisions to come.

The season ends. The receipts do not.

articles.title: The three-title standard: Soranno's era
articles.author: The 201 Archive
articles.excerpt: Nicholas Soranno won it all in 2014, 2016 and 2018 — a benchmark for everyone chasing league immortality.
articles.body:
Nicholas Soranno owns three titles in the archive: 2014, 2016 and 2018.

The streak crossed the original scoring format into the keeper years and made Soranno the league's all-time championship leader as recorded in the 2025 presentation.

Will anybody catch him in the dynasty era?

articles.title: 2022: The year of two champions
articles.author: The 201 Archive
articles.excerpt: A postponed NFL game led to the league's first shared title: Kevin Goyenechea and Josh Colon.
articles.body:
The 2022 fantasy championship ended without a single winner. Following the Damar Hamlin game stoppage, Kevin Goyenechea and Josh Colon agreed to share the crown.

It remains one of the most unusual endings in The 201 Invitational archive. John Curley, meanwhile, posted 1,844.12 points for a scoring-format record but still missed the top three.

seasons.notes: The inaugural season. Kevin Goyenechea founded the league and served as its first commissioner. Michael Huss defeated Lochlan Dougherty to become the first champion.
Eugene Williams and John Curley joined the league. After finishing last in the inaugural season, Adam Malik completed a remarkable turnaround and won the championship against RJ Pita.
Nicholas Soranno captured the first of three titles. Ryan Baker scored 1,335 points, a benchmark for the original standard-scoring format. The season was also remembered for a controversial trade.
Josh Colon and Robbie Arrigo entered the league. Vincent Troisi won his first championship, defeating commissioner Kevin Goyenechea.
Ryan Reynolds joined the league. Nicholas Soranno defeated Tim Swatek to claim his second championship. The draft is remembered for an ambitious homemade board that did not survive the night.
RJ Pita defeated Josh Colon to earn his championship. Pressure mounted on founding commissioner Kevin Goyenechea.
The league switched to a keeper format. Michael Huss set a format scoring mark with 1,734.78 points. Nicholas Soranno defeated Lochlan Dougherty and became the first three-time champion.
Anthony Lisi joined the league. A draft at Brother Jimmy's BBQ required a restart after four rounds. Nickolas Huss defeated Ryan Reynolds for the championship.
An era ended as Kevin Goyenechea stepped down as commissioner and Michael Huss took over. Josh Colon defeated Nicholas Soranno for the title.

Eder Dadul and Brian Lee joined the league after Ryan Reynolds and Ryan Baker departed. The presentation's championship recap lists Vincent Troisi as champion and Eder Dadul as runner-up; a narrative slide gives a conflicting result, so the recap table is used here.

The Damar Hamlin game stoppage led to a split championship between Kevin Goyenechea and Josh Colon — the first co-champions in league history. John Curley scored 1,844.12 points, a mark for the third scoring format, but did not finish in the top three.
Robbie Arrigo won the championship against Kevin Goyenechea. The league announced that 2024 would be the final year of the keeper-era format.
Brian Lee defeated Josh Colon to become the final champion of the original keeper-era 201 Invitational. The league prepared to leave ESPN and transition to dynasty play.
The 2025 presentation proposed the new dynasty era and migration from ESPN to Sleeper. The slide deck does not include the 2025 season results; add those when available.
The 2026 season has not yet been added to the archive. Championship, final standings and season leaders are pending.
